signature.name: VTask.leastOfBdd
signature.type: {P : ℤ → Prop} -> [DecidablePred P] -> (b : ℤ) -> (Hb : ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → b ≤ z) -> (Hinh : ∃ z, P z) -> { lb // P lb ∧ ∀ (z : ℤ), P z → lb ≤ z }

conventions.statement: The lower bound `b` is not required to satisfy `P`; it only needs to be a value below all satisfiers.
conventions.note: Any valid lower bound works; the result is independent of the specific bound chosen.

conventions.statement: Two calls with different valid lower bounds `b` and `b'` for the same predicate `P` return subtypes whose underlying integers are definitionally equal.
conventions.note: Captured by the theorem coe_leastOfBdd_eq in Mathlib.

facts.statement: ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (b : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z : ℤ, P z → b ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z : ℤ, P z), IsLeast {z | P z} (VTask.leastOfBdd b Hb Hinh : ℤ)

facts.statement: ∀ (P : ℤ → Prop) [DecidablePred P] (b b' : ℤ) (Hb : ∀ z : ℤ, P z → b ≤ z) (Hb' : ∀ z : ℤ, P z → b' ≤ z) (Hinh : ∃ z : ℤ, P z), (VTask.leastOfBdd b Hb Hinh : ℤ) = (VTask.leastOfBdd b' Hb' Hinh : ℤ)
